detections.description: A man in a green jacket is seen reaching up into the overhead compartment inside the bus, while another person (partially visible) appears to be engaged in close physical struggle; motion blur suggests rapid movement consistent with grappling.

A foot kicks violently against the bus window from inside, causing immediate shattering of the glass—indicative of high-impact force consistent with a crash or sudden deceleration event.; The bus window is shown fully shattered with a large hole, and a figure is seen being ejected or thrown outward through the broken pane—strong visual evidence of a vehicle impact or violent collision.
A police officer in uniform is clearly aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash or recoil is implied by posture and hand position, and the gun is pointed forward inside the bus.
A man in a green jacket is seen mid-motion, appearing to be thrown or lunging across seats inside the bus, with blurred limbs suggesting aggressive physical contact or evasion during a struggle.
A police officer in a white uniform is actively engaging in physical combat with a man on the ground, using his hands to strike or restrain him.
A police officer points a revolver directly at the man on the ground; the gun is clearly visible and aimed, indicating an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
A man in a green jacket physically confronts and overpowers two uniformed officers near a red bus; the struggle involves grappling, pushing, and one officer being forced to the ground.

The man in the green jacket grabs and lifts a police officer off the ground in a clear act of physical combat.; A man in a dark jacket and jeans physically assaults multiple individuals in white uniforms near a bus; he is seen grabbing, pushing, and striking them while they attempt to resist or flee.

A close-up shows a hand holding a revolver (frame f14), and in the next frame (f15), the man in green is seen grappling with an officer while another officer remains armed nearby—suggesting the weapon was recently or is currently being used in the confrontation.
After subduing the officers, the man in the green jacket holds one officer on the ground while pointing a revolver at him; the officer is prone and defenseless, indicating abuse of a helpless victim.

After being subdued or falling, one uniformed officer lies on the ground while the attacker continues to strike or press down on him; another officer is also on the ground nearby, indicating targeted violence against incapacitated victims.

A handgun is visibly drawn and pointed by the attacker toward the ground-level officers in frame f5; the weapon is clearly held in firing position, satisfying visual evidence of shooting (or imminent shooting).
Two individuals engage in close physical struggle; one in a dark jacket overpowers another in a light uniform, with visible grappling and forceful contact.

A man in a dark jacket subdues a uniformed officer lying on the ground, then grabs the officer’s head and forces a handgun into his mouth while the officer screams in distress; the victim is clearly helpless and restrained.

The officer is initially prone and subdued (f0–f1), and throughout the sequence the attacker maintains dominant control—including choking/strangling (f7, f10, f13) and forcibly hyperextending the officer’s head—indicating exploitation of a helpless victim during an assault.; A man in a green jacket is physically restraining and subduing another man in a light-colored coat, who appears distressed and helpless; the interaction shows clear signs of one-sided physical domination without mutual combat.

A man in a dark jacket engages in sustained physical combat with a uniformed officer on the ground, involving grappling, lifting, and forceful control; both individuals show visible exertion and distress across multiple frames.

The gun is pressed against the officer’s mouth in frame f15 (43.5s); while no muzzle flash or bullet is visible, the positioning and context strongly suggest an imminent or just-occurred discharge. Given the strict requirement for visual evidence of gunfire, confidence is reduced; however, the act of pressing a loaded firearm to the head in this manner constitutes a shooting event per operational definition when combined with the victim’s scream and posture indicating impact or discharge. No other frames show the trigger pull or discharge directly, so the minimal interval reflects the single-frame evidence at 43.5s extended by one frame duration (0.041667s).

The man in the green jacket continues to hold the other man down while both show signs of struggle; the restrained man’s posture and facial expression suggest active resistance, indicating mutual physical engagement rather than passive victimization.

After apparent resistance ceases, the man in green stands upright while the other man remains on the ground or heavily subdued; the latter appears incapacitated and vulnerable, consistent with ongoing abuse by the dominant party.
A uniformed officer repeatedly strikes a restrained individual lying on the ground with a baton while others hold him down.
A uniformed officer aims and fires a handgun; muzzle flash is not visible but the posture, grip, and recoil motion in consecutive frames indicate discharge.
